lead_headline: Restaurant tracker completes 19th consecutive zero-lead day on Sunday as June detection shutdown extends across metro

restaurant.blurb: Zero new leads today—Sunday continues June's total detection freeze now spanning 19 consecutive days without openings or closures logged across all neighborhoods.

liquor.blurb: Zero new applications today—Sunday applications desk went dark after Saturday's 350-filing deluge. Weekend saw Spitz Mediterranean (2615 Walnut), Dry Dock Pub on Pearl (1101 S Pearl), and Madeline (1313 E 6th Ave) clear Denver approvals. Hotel & Restaurant licenses drove Saturday's backlog clearance, RiNo and Capitol Hill leading neighborhood activity. Zero status changes, zero removals logged—system resting after weekend processing surge cleared June's two-week dormancy.

reputation.blurb: 3 mentions yesterday—Saturday coverage landed from Denver Post (Warrior Sports founder's $12M Cherry Hills mansion listing), Facebook (Englewood romance bookstore opening), and Reddit community discussions. Weekly tally: 47 mentions across 11 sources, up 27% from prior week's 37 as mid-June momentum accelerates. Denver Post dominated with 20 citations (43% share), Reddit contributed 6, social platforms split remainder. Week showed strong recovery after May's drought—Lakewood office tower discount sale, Cherry Hills luxury listings, local business launches driving coverage. Current week's gain (+10 vs prior period) reverses two-month slide as media attention rebuilds entering Father's Day weekend.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +0 yesterday (0 new, 0 canceled) marks Saturday sabbath, holding MTD net at +13 (+1.0/day) and 90-day net at +130. Zero-net Saturday follows Friday's +3 uptick as weekend subscription activity typically flatlines. Recent fortnight remains choppy: six zero-net days scattered among modest gains, with June 5's +4 and June 12's +3 providing only meaningful lift. Current 7-day window (+4 net) trails prior period (+11) by 64% as June's daily pace (+1.0) continues drifting below YTD velocity (+1.2), confirming persistent Q2 cooling despite sporadic Friday strength before weekend dormancy.
